An '''Astromech Ghost Costume''' was a large piece of cloth that could be placed over an [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]]. It was in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to celebrate [[Halloween/Legends|Halloween]].<ref name="CWA">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Astromech Ghost Costumes are an item obtainable in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures]], they can be placed on players pet droids.
